displayName: Triple-Species Cover Crop Mix (rye + vetch + radish)
benefit: Three-species cover crop combining a grass (cereal rye), a legume (hairy vetch), and a brassica (tillage radish) outperforms any single species on biomass, weed suppression, and nutrient cycling. Standard rotation cover ahead of vegetable cash crops.

members.title: Drill triple mix in late summer
members.body: Drill rye at 60 lb, hairy vetch at 25 lb, and tillage radish at 5 lb per acre in late August. Inoculate vetch with proper Rhizobium. Roller-crimp at vetch full bloom the following spring.
